headline: Strategic Lines Seethe Across Divided Sectors
war_summary: The latest watch finds the chief struggle concentrated in a handful of divided sectors. Weathered Expanse leads the ledger with 56 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though none arrived in the newest two; its current holdings stand six Colonial to three Warden, while casualties and enlistments accelerate. Stlican Shelf follows with 40 events, two in the latest two hours, and a five-to-three Colonial advantage with one base neutral. Godcrofts has reached 30 events, but shows no fresh movement in two hours and now stands six Colonial to three Warden. Stonecradle records 17 events, including three recent changes, with four Colonial bases against five Warden. Callahan’s Passage is active again, posting three events in two hours amid sharply rising casualties and enlistments, though all ten bases remain Warden-held. Linn Mercy remains a heavily contested six-to-five Warden sector with 27 events, but its latest recorded movement is several hours old. Elsewhere, Fisherman’s Row and Marban Hollow remain watchable, while most other regions report no strategic-base activity.
